img.11.description: Portrait-oriented outdoor photograph. A broad blue sky with thin, wispy horizontal white clouds fills the top. Across the upper middle, a distant snow-capped mountain range rises above lower cloud bands. Below, a large dark-green forested hill dominates the center, with a dense cluster of small buildings, many with light or reddish roofs, strung along its ridge and slopes. In the foreground, bright green grassy or terrace-like hillsides descend, and a narrow winding path or road cuts through them. No clear people, animals, text, logos, or products are visible at the supplied preview resolution.
img.11.title: Snow-Capped Mountain Range Above a Forested Hill Town
img.11.usage_note: Use for nature, travel, climate, environment, mountain, forest, or editorial content; as a hero or section background when text can sit over the sky; as a card image for outdoor or landscape themes; when a calm, expansive, elevated mood is wanted.

img.12.description: A portrait-oriented color photograph showing two people working in a lush green field. The person in the foreground, left of center, wears a light green/white long-sleeved shirt, a pink/red patterned headscarf, dark pants, and a light-colored apron/skirt; a large brown woven basket is carried on their back with a strap across the chest. They are bent forward, hands reaching into dense tea bushes. Behind and to the right, a second person in a white long-sleeved shirt and a striped headscarf also bends over the bushes, picking. The foreground is filled with tea bushes and tall grass-like leaves. The background is a hillside covered in tea bushes, with tall trees and an overcast gray sky. No text, logos, or graphics are visible.
img.12.title: Two people harvesting tea in a hillside field
img.12.usage_note: Use as a card image, hero image, section background, or inline image in contexts related to agriculture, tea harvesting, rural livelihoods, or sustainability. Works well as a full-bleed background with a dark overlay for text legibility.

img.13.description: A portrait-oriented landscape photograph looking down into a steep valley. A winding river or stream runs from the middle distance toward the lower right. Forested mountains rise on both sides, with terraced fields visible on the left hillside. A leafy tree branch enters from the upper left foreground. The sky is pale and hazy, and distant ridges fade into atmospheric mist. Dense green vegetation fills the lower foreground. No people, text, logos, or products are clearly visible.
img.13.title: Hazy Mountain Valley with Winding River and Terraced Hillside

img.14.description: Vertical photograph of a green, grass-covered hillside under an overcast sky. Dense dark-green trees and shrubs cover the lower slope and foreground. Several small buildings with grey metal roofs, a blue roof, and light-colored walls appear among the trees. White mist drifts across the middle of the slope. No people, text, logos, or products are clearly visible.
img.14.title: Misty Green Hillside with Village Houses
img.14.usage_note: Use as a moody landscape photograph for environmental, climate, nature, travel, or rural-community themes.

img.15.description: Portrait photograph of a hazy industrial-rural scene. A tall cylindrical chimney stands in the right foreground; its upper section is dark and weathered and capped with a black top. A second, thinner chimney rises in the midground left and emits a white smoke or steam plume that drifts to the right. In the background left, a green steel truss bridge or structure spans horizontally. The middle distance contains low buildings, boundary walls, scattered trees, palm trees, and flat fields or plots. The foreground shows a concrete retaining wall or platform, rubble, dirt piles, and small concrete blocks. The sky is pale, beige-gray, and hazy. The palette is muted with dusty browns, grays, ochres, sparse greens, a green bridge, and white smoke. No readable text, logo, or watermark is visible in the image.
img.15.title: Two Industrial Chimneys in a Hazy Rural-Industrial Landscape
img.15.usage_note: Use as a documentary or editorial image for climate, industrial emissions, air quality, carbon removal, industrial decarbonization, or rural-industrial landscape topics. It suits serious, grounded, report-style layouts, cards, and article support images where a muted, atmospheric tone is appropriate.

img.16.description: A photorealistic landscape image of a hazy industrial area with a tall stack and white smoke.
img.16.title: Hazy Industrial Landscape with Tall Stack and Steam Plume
img.16.usage_note: Appropriate for environmental/conservation contexts, industrial emissions stories, corporate ESG visuals, and atmospheric editorial features. Use as a environmental impact visual.

img.17.title: Foggy Cityscape with Tall Slender Tower, Domes, and Palms

img.18.description: A blue-toned mountain ridge in mist with a mirrored reflection below, rendered with a horizontal glitch-like texture and dark vignette edges.
img.18.title: Misty Blue Mountain Ridge With Glitch Reflection
img.18.usage_note: Use as a background or mood-setting illustration for atmospheric, technology, or nature-adjacent content.

img.2.description: A stylized, painterly landscape built from layered hillsides and flowing line textures. A bright chartreuse-to-yellow-green band sweeps diagonally from the upper left across the middle of the frame, reading as a sunlit valley floor, river of light, or mist-filled gorge. To the upper right, a terraced slope is drawn as stacked contour rows in warm olive and pale tan, with rounded dark-green tree clusters sitting along the terrace edges. Upper-left and center hills are filled with dense, wavy linework in mid and deep greens. The lower left quadrant is a dark teal body of water rendered with concentric swirling lines, and directly below the bright band a striped vertical texture panel drops toward the bottom edge, giving a stepped or waterfall-like transition. The bottom right holds a dark, hedgerow-like mass of rounded green foliage. Small pale cream dots are scattered across the sky area and the bright band, resembling sparks, fireflies, or light particles.
img.2.title: Illustrated Green Terraced Hillside with Luminous Valley and Striped Water Fall-Off
img.2.usage_note:
Use when a calm, optimistic, environmental or agricultural tone is needed and the layout can carry a text overlay.
Use as a full-bleed band behind headline copy or as a wide section divider.
Use cropped to the terraced slope or the bright valley band as a small card or thumbnail image.
Use to signal landscape regeneration, tea/agriculture, climate or nature restoration subject matter where the surrounding copy supplies the specifics.

img.3.description: A hand-painted-looking illustration of a dark-haired man wearing round-framed glasses, head and shoulders visible above the surface of a swirling, teal-green and turquoise current. A large diffuse glow of yellow, gold and orange surrounds his head and shoulders, brightest behind and below him, and scatters into many round golden specks and dots that float across the water like particles or embers. In the upper-left corner a dark navy-to-black mass of curving striations intrudes, contrasting with the pale mint and cyan water elsewhere. Lighter, pale-blue swirls and two faint circular bright patches appear in the upper middle and upper right. The composition is horizontal, panoramic, with the figure placed right of centre and facing left into the current.
img.3.title: Swimmer in a Luminous Teal Current
img.3.usage_note: Suitable as a conceptual hero or feature image for climate, carbon removal, environmental, ocean, science or climate-tech storytelling where a metaphorical human figure within a natural system is appropriate.

img.4.description: Top-down illustration of a single wooden rowboat with a tan hull and reddish-brown interior floating on deep teal water. The boat leaves a white wake. The water is filled with swirling concentric lines and ripples. Large organic landmasses or coral-like formations flank the left and right sides, textured with small leaf-like or coral-like marks in cream, pale yellow, olive, and pink. A pale, twisted funnel or spiral cloud descends from the top center toward the water. Small fish-like or debris shapes appear in the water. No text is visible.
img.4.title: Top-down rowboat in swirling teal water with coral-like landmasses and a spiral funnel
img.4.usage_note: Use when a climate, ocean, exploration, or environmental theme needs a calm, narrative, hand-painted visual. Suitable as a wide banner or hero with a central focal point. Pairs well with mission statements about carbon removal, ocean health, or journey metaphors.

img.5.description: A painterly illustration of a person standing in a field.
img.5.title: Porterrait_of_a_Person_in_a_Field
img.5.usage_note: Use as a background image for a website section about agriculture or environment.

img.6.description: A large, roughly circular structure occupies the center-right of the frame against a solid black background. Its core is dark with dense purple, blue, and pink speckling. A thick, irregular ring surrounds the core, composed of blue, red, green, and purple shapes. To the left, a diffuse cloud of tiny pink, purple, blue, and white particles spreads outward. Several smaller spherical objects with spiky protrusions are scattered around the large structure, including at upper right, lower right, and left. The overall appearance resembles a microscopic or scientific visualization of viruses and cells.
img.6.title: Microscopic Virus-like Particles and Central Cell Structure on Black Background
img.6.usage_note: Use as a generic scientific/medical illustration for articles about viruses, public health, disease eradication, vaccination, or microbiology. Suitable for dark-themed layouts where the black background can blend or serve as negative space.

img.7.description: Square image on a black ground. Near the top, centered, white serif text reads 'The Alchemy of Ash'. Below, a diagonal band of orange and red flames, rendered with a visible halftone dot pattern, runs from the lower-left edge up toward the middle-left. To its right is a large dark mass of charred or burnt vegetation streaked with yellow-green, occupying the center and right of the frame. Two human figures appear on the right: one higher up in pale/white clothing, walking or standing amid the dark mass, and one lower right in a white shirt and shorts holding a long pole or tool whose tip carries a small red-orange object. The lower-left corner holds a grey-tan, wavy, ash- or water-like texture. The overall palette is black, white, orange-red, yellow-green and muted grey-tan.
img.7.title: The Alchemy of Ash — halftone fire-and-field collage with two figures
img.7.usage_note: Use as an editorial card or hero image for a long-form story about soil, land regeneration, fire, or climate recovery. The built-in headline makes it suitable as a self-contained article thumbnail; the dark field and high contrast let it sit on light or dark page backgrounds.

img.8.description: A square graphic on a deep purple background. Centered at the top is the text 'Bengal Renaissance Project' in a light cream serif typeface, arranged on three lines. Two small cream plus-sign ornaments flank the text. Below, a cross-shaped (plus-shaped) window reveals a painted scene: a long, curved wooden boat with a high prow, carrying several dark figures, on water. The water and background are rendered in swirling, textured strokes of blue, green, and yellow. A staircase or stepped structure appears on the right side of the cross window. The cross shape is outlined by a thin, faint rounded rectangle and small cream plus-sign corner marks.
img.8.title: Bengal Renaissance Project — Cross-Cropped Boat Illustration
img.8.usage_note: Suitable as a card image, editorial inline graphic, or section visual for cultural, historical, or educational content related to Bengal, the Renaissance, or maritime themes. The square format and clear typography make it adaptable for social media or web cards.

img.9.description: Square graphic on a dark navy background. Centered near the top is cream serif text reading 'Darjeeling' on the first line and 'Revival Project' on the second line, flanked by small cream plus signs. Below, a thin rounded-rectangle outline frames a central illustration: a person with dark hair, wearing a purple dress, seated on a wooden stool at a wooden loom or table, facing left. The illustration background is a stylized landscape with teal/green wavy lines at the top, tan/beige middle, and orange/yellow textured lower area. The central illustration has a stepped/ziggurat top edge. No logo is visible.
img.9.title: Darjeeling Revival Project — square promotional graphic
img.9.usage_note: Use when a square, text-led graphic is needed to introduce a named project or initiative, especially in a climate, community, or craft context. Suitable for hero/section placement, social cards, or editorial headers where the title and central illustration should remain prominent.

mark.description: A square, monochrome raster preview showing an abstract geometric arrangement of thick black rectangular bars on a white field. Four plus/cross-like signs sit near the four corners. A vertical bar is centered at the top edge and another at the bottom edge. A horizontal bar is centered at the left edge and another at the right edge. The center of the composition is empty. The bars have squared ends and uniform apparent thickness. No text, letters, numerals, or recognizable objects are visible. The background appears opaque white.
